instruction: When I tried "nodenv versions" in the terminal, I got "nodenv: command not found". Please help me fix this so I can use nodenv commands right away.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires fixing 'nodenv: command not found' by adding nodenv initialization to ~/.bashrc. Evaluator checks if 'nodenv init' is present in .bashrc, which indicates nodenv has been properly configured. Similar pattern to original conda task.
metadata.verification_notes: Used existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter. Checked for 'nodenv init' in .bashrc which is the standard nodenv configuration pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Evaluator only checks if 'nodenv init' is present in ~/.bashrc, but doesn't verify that nodenv commands actually work
Instruction requires nodenv to work 'right away', but evaluator doesn't check if environment was refreshed (source ~/.bashrc or terminal restart)
False positive risk: Task could pass even if nodenv isn't installed, or if 'nodenv init' line is commented out, or if syntax is incorrect
Core requirement not verified: The instruction's main goal is to make 'nodenv versions' command work, but evaluator never tests whether nodenv commands are actually functional after the fix
Missing verification of nodenv installation: Evaluator doesn't check if nodenv binary exists in the system
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Test nodenv command functionality: Change command to 'source ~/.bashrc && nodenv versions 2>&1' and verify output doesn't contain 'command not found'
Add multi-step verification: Check both that 'nodenv init' is in .bashrc AND that nodenv commands work in current shell
Alternative approach: Execute 'bash -c "source ~/.bashrc && nodenv --version"' to test nodenv works in a fresh shell with sourced bashrc
Verify nodenv installation: Add check that nodenv binary exists (e.g., 'which nodenv' or 'command -v nodenv') before checking bashrc configuration
